_what_this_is: PRE-REGISTERED TRIAL of THE JUDGED CUT — the operator's cut-and-flip, but with the cut decided by a READER looking at the day rather than by a fixed point-distance. Registered 2026-09-12 after the mechanical version was measured at zero over 10.5 years, and because the difference between the mechanical rule and what he actually does is the entire question.
registered_by: operator: 'we start automating our entries using when and the 10 minute delay... if it starts grinding the other way. we cut it quickly. and then buy in that direction too... i know youre going to tell me this is risky behaviour. but when i have time and i can focus. i do this manually and it works'

_why_the_mechanical_version_is_NOT_what_.measured: 2,656 sessions, 2015-01-02..2025-07-24, entry from drift.compute() replayed causally (validated against the driftlab record: 232 agree, 0 disagree)
_why_the_mechanical_version_is_NOT_what_.and_the_number_that_was_withdrawn: On the 13-month driftlab window the same code said A = -26.4 (NQ) / -38.4 (MNQ) pt/session and that a cut was worth +21 to +43. Over 10.5 years A is +0.9. THE WINDOW WAS THE FINDING, NOT THE RULE — the third time in one night a promising short-window result dissolved on the long tape.
_why_the_mechanical_version_is_NOT_what_.year_instability: Cutting HURT in 2018 (A +8.6 vs B +1.3) and HELPED in 2020 (A -8.8 vs C -0.6). The sign flips by era, which is the dominant failure mode the falsification literature names.

hypothesis: A reader that looks at the whole day can tell when a position is genuinely grinding against us, and cutting on THAT judgement beats both holding and cutting at a fixed distance. The fixed-distance version is now known to be worth zero, so any value here is in the JUDGEMENT, not in the cutting.
_why_this_is_not_the_119_failed_calibrat: Those all searched for a LEVEL - $100 to $600, ATR-scaled, two-lot - and every one lost. This registers no level at all. It is the operator's own stated mechanism ('when it starts grinding the other way'), with the reader supplying the read.

arms.A_hold: THE INCUMBENT. Enter on drift's first confirmation, hold to the 20:40Z flat, no stop. What the rider does today. Measured at +0.9 pt/session over 10.5 years.
arms.B_fixed_cut: THE MECHANICAL CONTROL, and it is expected to add nothing: same entry, cut at 40pt, target 100pt, up to 3 flips. Measured at +1.0. It is in the trial precisely BECAUSE it is known to be zero — it is the yardstick the judgement has to beat.
arms.C_judged_cut: THE HYPOTHESIS. Same entry. The tape reader (gazbot7-tape-reader, phase 1, read-only) judges the open position every 2 minutes and its first CUT or CLAIM call is taken as the exit. No level, no distance, no threshold.

_the_reader: scripts/tape_reader.py. It sees the session open, the range and where price sits in it, VWAP stretch in ATR, six hours of 5-minute structure, the causal drift read, the position and each lot's distance to its rung. It answers HOLD/CLAIM/CUT/ADD with a reason. IT PLACES NOTHING — this trial grades a counterfactual built from its log.

verdict_rule.primary: C beats B on mean pt/session, day-clustered 95% bootstrap CI on the difference excluding zero
verdict_rule.secondary: C beats A on the same test
verdict_rule.CONFIRMED: both -> propose phase 2 (the reader gets ONE lot, claim/cut only, never add)
verdict_rule.REFUTED: C does not beat B -> the judgement adds nothing a fixed distance does not, and the reader stays read-only
verdict_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: fewer than 60 judged exits by the expiry
verdict_rule._the_power_problem_stated_honestly: At the per-session sd measured on this rule (213-239pt) a +20pt effect needs ~450 sessions for 80% power. THIS TRIAL CANNOT PROVE A SMALL EDGE AND IS NOT DESIGNED TO. It is designed to detect a LARGE one and to falsify the mechanics. If the reader's judged exits are merely indistinguishable from a fixed 40pt cut, that is a REFUTATION of the interesting claim and it is reachable at n=60.

what_this_trial_CAN_settle_in_60_session: Does the reader actually fire? A CUT call rate near zero, or on every session, both falsify it as a judge.
Does it fire on the sessions a human would? Graded against the operator's own manual claims on the sessions he was present.
Do its exits beat a fixed 40pt cut by a LARGE margin, or not at all.
Does the live implementation behave like the model - fill quality, timing, and whether 20:40 catches what is left.
rules_of_engagement: DO NOT give the reader an order path during this trial. C is a counterfactual built from its log.
DO NOT tune the reader's prompt mid-trial. A changed prompt restarts the count at zero.
DO NOT drop arm B because it is known to be zero. It is the yardstick; without it a good C cannot be attributed to judgement.
DO NOT read the interim and act on it.
The 10.5-year measurement above is the PRIOR, not a result of this trial.
status: REGISTERED — the reader is armed and logging; arm C accrues as soon as a position is open
